scientific_integrity: All new module assertions derive from an integral chain projection and signed join-Kuenneth reasoning. Exact finite face, boundary and signed trace tests are supplementary and cannot establish infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Equal-length finite spider arms only; integral automorphism homology but rational quotient homology only. Does not determine quotient integral torsion, quotient homotopy type or other graphs. The full labelled face criterion was published previously; no independent scientific audit or priority certification.
title: Integral arm-symmetry homology of spider general-position complexes
